requirements.general: A pass in SPM with a minimum of three (3) credits in any subject, or its equivalent; OR A pass in Sijil Tinggi Persekolahan Malaysia (STPM) with a minimum of Grade C (GP 2.00) in any subject, or its equivalent; OR A pass in Sijil Tinggi Agama Malaysia (STAM) with a minimum grade of Maqbul in any subject, or its equivalent; OR A pass in SKM Level 3 / Sijil Vokasional Malaysia (SVM) in a suitable field (Note: The HEPs are to conduct screening and provide a specific guidance for the respective discipline of the programme); OR A Certificate (Level 3, MQF) in a related field with minimum CGPA of 2.00 or its equivalent; OR A pass in UEC with a minimum of grade B in 3 subjects and pass English Other relevant equivalent qualifications recognised by the Malaysian Government; AND Pass an interview OR submission of portfolio as required by the HEPs. ENGLISH COMPETENCY REQUIREMENT (INTERNATIONAL STUDENT) Achieve a minimum score Band 2 in the Malaysian University English Test (MUET) or equivalent.
